contract.first_unregister: unregister() returns True when the selected listener exists and removes it
contract.repeated_unregister: A second unregister() of an already removed callback returns False
contract.registry_stability: Repeated unregister does not alter remaining listeners
contract.callback_isolation: Repeated unregister does not affect unrelated callbacks
contract.post_unregister_delivery: The removed callback receives no subsequent events
contract.remaining_callback_delivery: Remaining callbacks continue receiving emitted events
contract.permission_enforcement: Each unregister and emit operation continues to require the events permission
